科技產品加價令人疲於應付。近月 Apple 整條產品線紛紛加價，見到有貨品減價反而變得稀有。Amazon Basics 智能插座是少數能堅持價錢的例外之一。支援 Matter 標準，售價低於 10 美元，隨時成為我新的心水智能插座。讓我們一起看看。

HomeKit Weekly is a series focused on smart home accessories, automation tips, and tricks, and everything related to Apple's smart home framework.

Matter 兼容的威力

This Amazon Basics outlet's main selling point is Matter support. For Apple Home users, this means you can completely ignore Amazon's history of Alexa-only products. Since Matter establishes a universal standard for smart home hardware, pairing this outlet with Apple is just as simple as pairing it with Alexa or Google Home. You don't need to download an additional Amazon app — as long as you have a Matter-compatible Apple home hub at home, such as a HomePod mini or Apple TV 4K, the outlet can communicate directly with your existing Apple ecosystem over your Wi-Fi network. The Matter pairing code is included in the box.

簡單插座轉接器的優勢

I believe smart outlets are arguably one of the most versatile and important foundational components of any smart home system. While smart bulbs are great for overhead fixtures, outlet adapters bring automation to appliances that are hard to modify.

  • Seasonal lighting: A smart outlet is an absolute must-have in my home, especially during the holidays, letting you automate Christmas trees or string lights so you don't have to crawl behind furniture to manually turn them on every night. I keep my Christmas tree's dedicated outlet plugged in year-round.
  • Temperature shortcuts: You can plug space heaters, dehumidifiers, or floor fans into the outlet and pair them with temperature and humidity sensors in the room to automatically trigger these appliances.
  • Morning routines: After plugging a traditional coffee maker with a physical power switch into the outlet, you can set it to automatically start brewing the moment your wake-up alarm goes off, without having to walk to the kitchen to turn it on manually.

Another standout advantage of this outlet is its compact size. Early smart outlets were often bulky, typically taking over an entire two-outlet wall plate and forcing you to use a power strip. Amazon designed this outlet to be extremely compact, fitting perfectly into a single outlet and completely freeing up the second socket for other appliances — and if needed, you can even stack another smart outlet on top.

總結

Before picking up this Matter smart outlet from Amazon, there is one trade-off worth noting. This device only supports 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi and is not the Thread-equipped model. Compared to the near-instant response of Thread devices, Wi-Fi outlets occasionally have slight delays and add another entry to your router's legacy client list. However, at a price point under $10, complaining about the lack of Thread is short-sighted. I've been using it for several weeks now, and it has performed very reliably, following every command without question.

可從 Amazon 選購。
